Naquele dia ofereceram grandes sacrifícios e se alegraram, porque Deus os tinha alegrado com grande alegria; e também as mulheres e as crianças se alegraram; e a alegria de Jerusalém foi ouvida de longe.

posteriores.texto: Assim guardaram o encargo de seu Deus e o encargo da purificação — os cantores e os porteiros também —, conforme o mandamento de Davi e de Salomão, seu filho.
Porque, desde os dias antigos de Davi e Asafe, havia um chefe dos cantores, e cânticos de louvor e de ações de graças a Deus.

kjv.texto: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

vizinhos.43: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
vizinhos.45: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

vizinhos.46: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
